tool: authors' R DRoSC (Koo & Guo 2026, helpers.R), run live via Rscript
reference_repo: github.com/taehyeonkoo/DRoSC (src/helpers.R, sc() + DRoSC(), Inference=FALSE) -- cloned by reference.R into benchmarks/reference/.cache and sourced unmodified
solver: limSolve::lsei (installed from the GitHub CRAN mirror; see benchmarks/R/install_drosc.sh)
determinism: Inference=FALSE, so the worst-case point estimand is deterministic (no seed/cond); mlsynth's cvxpy solve matches the authors' lsei value-for-value (tau <= 1e-7, lambda=0 weights <= 1e-7).
notes: The perturbation union CI (Inference=TRUE) is stochastic/seed-dependent and is not pinned in the benchmark. The case BenchmarkSkipped()s when Rscript / limSolve / the clone is unavailable.
